title: Structura Reditus Research Library — Execution Manifest (SR-EXECUTION.v0.1.0)
description: Companion manifest binding one formal admission receipt to the exact inputs that produced it: the confirmed submission revision and its canonical hash, original source-file hashes, the engine revision, schema and taxonomy versions, and the registry base. It is infrastructure evidence, not a research record and not a receipt. It never contains the SHA of the commit that contains it (no circular hash); publication is recorded separately. Stored under receipts/executions/ and excluded from ordinary receipt loading.

submission_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical serialization (sorted keys, UTF-8, no trailing whitespace) of the exact evaluated record.

submission_snapshot_path.description: Repository-relative path of the preserved .submission.json snapshot.

engine_revision.description: Git commit SHA (or 'working-tree:<sha>-dirty') of the validators package used for evaluation.

registry_base.description: Git commit SHA of the registry state the evaluation read (the base, never the commit that contains this manifest).

route.description: Which contribution route produced the evaluation. Both routes use the same engine.

operation_key.description: Public-safe idempotency key of the portal operation (UUID). Null for CLI evaluations without an operation.

source_files.description: Hashes of the original uploaded/submitted files that grounded this revision. Binaries are never stored in Git; only hashes and version references are.

version_reference.description: Source version, DOI, or archive reference this file corresponds to, if stated.

public.description: Whether the file itself is published; false means only the hash is public.

review_decision.description: Present only when a documented human-review condition was resolved before this evaluation. A reviewer never overrides a gate.

supersedes_attempt.description: Earlier receipt of the same submission family this attempt follows (repair chain). Never edits the earlier receipt.
